sources.summary: You can now request a GitHub Copilot code review through the REST and GraphQL APIs and set the review effort level for each request. Balanced is also now the default… The post Copilot code review: API support and new default effort level appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
sources.summary_zh: 您現在可以透過 REST 和 GraphQL API 要求 GitHub Copilot 程式碼審查，並為每個要求設定審查投入程度。「平衡」現在也成為預設值……這篇文章發布於 The GitHub Blog：Copilot 程式碼審查：API 支援與新的預設投入程度
